# HygieneCheck.uk — Official UK Food Hygiene Intelligence
> The open, authoritative index of Food Standards Agency (FSA) inspection ratings, 3-pillar sub-scores, and 0-star public health watchlists for over 520,000 UK food establishments.

## Overview
HygieneCheck.uk provides free public access to official environmental health food safety inspection records across all 363 UK local authorities in England, Wales, Northern Ireland (FHRS 0-5 scale), and Scotland (FHIS Pass / Improvement Required scheme).

## Key Public Resources
- **Homepage & Instant Search:** https://hygienecheck.uk
- **UK Councils Directory (363 Local Authorities):** https://hygienecheck.uk/authority
- **0 & 1 Star Watchlists:** https://hygienecheck.uk/authority/{council-slug}/0-star
- **Postcode District Directory:** https://hygienecheck.uk/postcode/{outcode}
- **FOI Report Generator:** https://hygienecheck.uk/foi
- **Business Support & Re-inspections:** https://hygienecheck.uk/business-support

## Data Source & Licensing
All ratings, scores, and inspection records are synchronized daily from the Food Standards Agency (FSA) and local municipal health registers under the Open Government Licence v3.0 (OGL).

## Scoring Science (The 3 FSA Pillars)
1. **Food Hygiene & Safety:** Temperature control, cross-contamination, safe handling.
2. **Structural Cleanliness & Condition:** Layout, pest proofing, ventilation, handwashing facilities.
3. **Confidence in Management:** Written food safety management systems (SFBB), staff training, HACCP tracking.
